title: Safe Apply + Rollback (Optimize Config) — Release Engineering Rollout Checklist
body:
Doc owner: Connor O’Brien (Release Train)
Last reviewed with: Dylan/Chloe (Console), Mateo (Runtime), Sean/Neha (SRE), Fiona/Marcus (Security)

Purpose
- Checklist for rolling out “Safe apply + rollback mechanism” for Optimize config changes across internal -> Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
- This is the release-engineering view: flags, migrations, dashboards/alerts, comms, and “rollback the rollback” plan.

Scope reminder (what we’re launching)
- Config version store (immutable history) + APIs (list/get/diff/apply/rollback)
- Console history + compare + one-click rollback
- Safe-apply preflight validation + optional canary apply + metric gates
- Runtime apply locking/lease + propagation status
- Audit logging + RBAC permissions

Non-goals for this release
- Auto-rollback without human confirmation
- Partial/patched rollback of only some fields (whole-config rollback only)

====================================================================================================
0) Release prerequisites (do not start rollout until these are true)

[ ] Linear milestone status is green for Phase 1/2 items in PM-412 (no P0/P1 open)
[ ] E2E suite passing in staging for: create version -> safe-apply -> canary gate -> forced failure -> rollback -> state/audit assertions (ENG-4829)
[ ] On-call runbook draft is “ready for use” and reviewed by SRE lead + on-call owner (Sean + Rafael)
[ ] Security review done for RBAC + audit fields + retention (Fiona + Marcus)
[ ] Observability dashboards + alert rules merged and visible (observability-pack/pr-733)
[ ] Incident-bot changes deployed (incident-bot/pr-219) so incidents get rollback deep-links + correlation IDs
[ ] Private installer migration plan reviewed (private-installer/pr-302) including offline/air-gapped guidance

Blocking sign-offs needed to proceed:
- Console/Platform engineering: Dylan Brooks
- Runtime: Mateo Alvarez
- SRE: Neha Kapoor or Sean Gallagher
- Security Ops: Fiona McCarthy
- Release train: Connor O’Brien

====================================================================================================
1) Feature flags & config toggles

Flags (control plane / platform services)
[ ] optimize_config_versioning_enabled (default OFF) — gate reads/writes to version store
[ ] optimize_config_safe_apply_enabled (default OFF) — gate validator + preview/diff endpoints
[ ] optimize_config_canary_apply_enabled (default OFF) — gate canary rollout primitive + metric gates
[ ] optimize_config_rollback_enabled (default OFF) — gate rollback endpoint + console button
[ ] optimize_config_audit_events_enabled (default ON in non-prod, OFF->ON in prod only after validation) — emit audit logs
[ ] optimize_config_apply_locking_enabled (default OFF->ON with runtime deployment) — runtime lease/locking semantics

Flags (Console)
[ ] console_optimize_config_history_ui (default OFF)
[ ] console_optimize_config_compare_ui (default OFF)
[ ] console_optimize_config_rollback_ui (default OFF)
[ ] console_optimize_config_safe_apply_wizard (default OFF)

Notes / gotchas
- Keep UI flags separate from API flags. We’ve had cases where API is enabled but UI is hidden (or vice versa), which confuses SRE during incidents.
- Dedicated tenants: verify flag propagation to tenant config (SUP-2431 was caused by RBAC/flag mismatch).

====================================================================================================
2) Database migrations, backfills, retention

Version store schema + migrations (ENG-4821)
[ ] Migration applied in staging
[ ] Migration applied in prod control plane DBs (all regions) with deploy window + rollback plan
[ ] Verify indexes exist for: (scope_key, created_at), (scope_key, version_number), (request_id/idempotency_key)

Backfill / v0 creation
[ ] Backfill job creates v0 versions for all currently-live Optimize configs per scope
[ ] Backfill writes author/source metadata as “system_backfill” (not a real user) + timestamp
[ ] Confirm backfill is idempotent and safe to re-run

Retention / storage
[ ] Confirm retention policy configured (enterprise retention expectations; do not delete audit logs early)
[ ] Confirm version history retention setting: default 180 days for Hosted; Dedicated/Private configurable per tenant contract
[ ] Confirm redaction rules for sensitive fields in audit logs (per Security audit spec)

Rollback of migration
- Plan A: DB migration rollback (only if safe and explicitly tested)
- Plan B (preferred): keep schema, disable feature flags, stop writes, keep reads stable
[ ] Document which migrations are reversible vs forward-only

====================================================================================================
3) RBAC & permissions rollout

New permissions (ENG-4830)
[ ] optimize.config.apply
[ ] optimize.config.rollback
[ ] optimize.config.view_history
[ ] optimize.config.compare
[ ] optimize.config.safe_apply

Role mapping
[ ] Internal: “SRE On-call” role has rollback permission in prod
[ ] Internal: “Support” role can view history but cannot apply/rollback in prod
[ ] Customer (Enterprise): default is view-only unless tenant admin enables apply/rollback roles
[ ] Dedicated: verify tenant RBAC sync works (SUP-2431 regression check)

Break-glass access
[ ] Define break-glass procedure for rollback if RBAC misconfigured during incident (who can grant, how logged)
[ ] Confirm break-glass action is audit-logged and has ticket reference requirement

====================================================================================================
4) Runtime + propagation readiness

Runtime apply/rollback semantics (ENG-4827, PR-10479)
[ ] Runtime build deployed to staging clusters
[ ] Lock/lease enabled and validated under concurrent apply attempts
[ ] Propagation status returned to control plane and rendered in Console (progress + failures)
[ ] Confirm no “split brain”: if partial propagation happens, rollback endpoint blocks or forces reconcile per design

Cache / batching / quantization edge cases
[ ] KV cache invalidation behavior validated on rollback for cache-related knobs
[ ] Continuous batching toggles don’t wedge scheduler after rollback
[ ] Quantization profile swap rollback tested (warmup + correctness)
[ ] Document known issues and safe defaults (link Confluence known-issues page)

====================================================================================================
5) Safe-apply preflight validation & diffs

Validator service (ENG-4824, PR-10466)
[ ] Schema validation on incoming config + scope (route/model/customer/region)
[ ] Guardrails enabled: max batch size bounds, cache toggle constraints, quantization compatibility
[ ] Dry-run propagation simulation returns warning/error set (non-blocking warnings vs blocking errors)

Diff/preview format
[ ] Diff payload stable for nested config; Console can render without truncating important fields
[ ] Preview includes blast radius: where it will apply (clusters/regions/tenants)
[ ] Preview includes “why blocked” text suitable for on-call (avoid internal-only jargon)

Canary apply + metric gates (PR-10511)
[ ] Canary percentage default set (e.g., 5%) and override requires justification
[ ] Metric gates configured for tier (Hosted vs Dedicated) and environment
[ ] Abort semantics: if gates fail, rollout halts and can revert to last known good version

====================================================================================================
6) Observability, dashboards, alerts

Metrics (ENG-4828)
[ ] config_apply_latency_seconds (p50/p95)
[ ] config_apply_success_total / config_apply_failure_total
[ ] rollback_success_total / rollback_failure_total
[ ] config_apply_in_progress_gauge (or equivalent)
[ ] propagation_stuck_total / apply_lock_contention_total

Dashboards
[ ] “Config change health” dashboard deployed (observability-pack/pr-733)
[ ] Panels show correlation ID/request ID and link out to audit log and version history
[ ] Dashboard includes per-scope breakdown (customer/route/model/region)

Alerts
[ ] Alert: elevated apply failures (rate threshold over 10m)
[ ] Alert: stuck rollout (in_progress > N minutes)
[ ] Alert: audit event emission drop (suspicious / pipeline broken)
[ ] Alert routing: #eng-oncall + pager policy confirmed

Incident-bot / deploy-bot hooks
[ ] incident-bot posts “config change applied” and “rollback executed” messages with deep link to Console + request ID
[ ] Notifications redact config payload; include only version id, scope, actor, ticket link

====================================================================================================
7) Rollback plan for the rollback feature (meta-rollback)

Principle: if rollback system misbehaves, we must be able to disable it fast without losing ability to stabilize inference.

Failure modes we’re planning for
- Rollback endpoint returns 500 / timeouts during incident
- Apply locking wedges and blocks all future applies/rollbacks
- Console UI shows wrong blast radius or wrong target version
- Audit logging pipeline overload causes control plane latency

Immediate mitigations
[ ] Single kill-switch: optimize_config_versioning_enabled OFF (stops version writes/reads; confirm it degrades safely)
[ ] Separate kill-switch: optimize_config_rollback_enabled OFF (disables rollback actions but keeps history visible)
[ ] Separate kill-switch: console_optimize_config_rollback_ui OFF (hides button if backend unstable)
[ ] If apply locking wedges: optimize_config_apply_locking_enabled OFF (runtime accepts direct apply) — confirm safe per runtime lead before using

Operational fallback if feature disabled
- Revert to last known good Optimize config using existing manual mechanism (document exact steps + owners)
- Note: manual path must still emit an incident note with what was changed (even if audit logs are incomplete)

Post-mitigation requirement
[ ] File incident + follow-up Linear task if any of these kill-switches are used
[ ] Capture request IDs + version IDs + scope keys in incident channel

====================================================================================================
8) Rollout sequence (phased)

Phase A — Internal dogfood (Redwood-only tenants)
[ ] Enable versioning + history view in dev + staging
[ ] Enable rollback endpoint in staging; run game-day rollback (Rafael leads)
[ ] Enable in internal prod for a limited set of scopes (2-3 low-risk routes)
[ ] Validate MTTR: rollback executed < 5 minutes end-to-end (SRE target)

Phase B — Hosted sandbox -> Hosted prod
[ ] Hosted sandbox: enable safe-apply wizard + canary gates
[ ] Hosted prod: enable history view first (read-only), then safe-apply, then rollback
[ ] Confirm support readiness: playbook for customer questions + where to find audit entries

Phase C — Dedicated
[ ] Pick 1-2 design partners (Dedicated) with SRE coverage
[ ] Verify tenant RBAC mapping + UI visibility
[ ] Validate canary gates don’t conflict with customer’s external monitoring

Phase D — Private deployments
[ ] Private installer upgrade instructions published (internal first)
[ ] Confirm offline mode: audit log export + retention behavior documented
[ ] Confirm customer-managed DB sizing guidance included

Stop/rollback criteria for any phase
- Apply/rollback failure rate > threshold for 30m
- Any incident where rollback cannot be executed within SRE target window
- Evidence of partial propagation/split brain

====================================================================================================
9) Comms, training, and documentation

Runbooks
[ ] “Rollback Optimize config in production” runbook published + linked from on-call handbook
[ ] “Safe-apply preflight validation playbook” published

Training
[ ] 30-min on-call training session scheduled (Rafael + Kira) + recording link
[ ] Release notes internal post in #announcements with: where feature appears in Console, required permissions, escalation path

Customer-facing
[ ] External docs PR ready (redwood-docs/pr-911) and gated behind enterprise docs switch until GA
[ ] Support macros updated for audit log requests (SUP-2423 context)

====================================================================================================
10) Final go/no-go checklist (day-of)

Technical
[ ] All relevant services deployed in target env(s) with correct versions
[ ] Feature flags set per phase plan (screenshot/record values)
[ ] Migrations applied and validated (spot-check version creation + query performance)
[ ] Dashboards show expected baseline (no new alert noise)

Operational
[ ] On-call aware of rollout window and prepared for quick disable
[ ] Incident-bot verified posting correctly in target channels
[ ] Escalation contacts on standby (Console + Runtime)

Security/compliance
[ ] Audit events present for apply_attempted/applied/failed and rollback_* equivalents
[ ] Audit log fields look correct (actor, scope, request_id, ticket link / reason)
[ ] Redaction rules confirmed (no raw prompts/secrets)

Sign-off (fill in)
